primary.title: Zerodha Fund House unveils arbitrage fund for short-term cash management, investment starts at ₹5,000
primary.summary: The new fund offer is aimed at investors looking to park surplus money for relatively short periods while keeping volatility lower than that typically associated with pure equity funds.
